title: Sughra ki aa rahi thi sada
body:
Sughra ki aa rahi thi sada
<<MINI>>
(Marjayegi sughra, ghabrayegi sughra) x2
(Sughra ki aarahi thi sada saath le chalo, sab ke liye karungi dua saath le chalo) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Aadi nahi safar ki agar Amma thak gayee) x2
<<MINI>>
Asgher liya karu(n) gi utha saath le chalo
sab kai liye karu(n) gi dua saath le chalo
(Sughra ki aarahi thi sada saath le chalo, sab kai liye karun gi dua saath le chalo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Akber ki deed mai(n) hai meri zindagi ka raaz) x2
Akber sai yu(n) karo na juda, saath le chalo
<<MINI>>
Sab kai liye karu(n) gi dua saath le chalo
(Sughra ki aarahi thi sada saath le chalo, sab kai liye karun gi dua saath le chalo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Bin maa kai hu(n) yateem hi samjho agar mujhe) x2
Allah karega sabar aata saath le chalo
<<MINI>>
Sab kai liye karu(n) gi dua saath le chalo
(Sughra ki aarahi thi sada saath le chalo, sab kai liye karun gi dua saath le chalo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Jungle main niklay dam to wahi(n) dafan kijiye)
Hargiz nahi karu(n) gi gilla, saath le chalo
<<MINI>>
Sab kai liye karu(n) gi dua saath le chalo
(Sughra ki aarahi thi sada saath le chalo, sab kai liye karun gi dua saath le chalo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Akber ko sehra chahe Sakina hi bandhle) x2
De du(n) gi door se hi dua, saath le chalo
<<MINI>>
Sab kai liye karu(n) gi dua saath le chalo
(Sughra ki aarahi thi sada saath le chalo, sab kai liye karun gi dua saath le chalo) x2
(Marjayegi sughra, ghabrayegi sughra) x2
